preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
preconditions.description: Both input strings s and t consist only of lowercase English letters.
The lengths of s and t do not exceed 10^5 characters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(len({s[:i] + t[:j] for i in range(1, len(s) + 1) for j in range(1, len(t) + 1)}))
postconditions.description: The output is the count of distinct strings formed by concatenating every non-empty prefix of s with every non-empty prefix of t.
